entities.name: Johann Büttikofer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Büttikofer was a Swiss zoologist, who worked at the Blijdorp Zoological Garden in Rotterdam. After his retirement, he settled in Bern, Switzerland. For his extensive contributions to the knowledge of Liberian fauna based on two zoological expeditions to the Republic of Liberia, he is regarded as the Father of Liberian Natural History.
